Specification: This module specifies a network message buffer abstraction parameterized by a delivery guarantee. It models four network behaviors: ordered without duplication, ordered with duplication, reordered without duplication, and reordered with duplication, all selected by the constant Guarantee. The module defines how messages are initialized, added, removed, queried by destination and source, observed to increase, and nondeterministically dropped under each guarantee, using a single state variable messages.
IfThenElse: IF m \notin (DOMAIN msgs) THEN msgs @@ (m :> 1) ELSE [ msgs EXCEPT ![m] = @ + 1 ]
IF msgs[m] = 1 THEN [ msg \in ((DOMAIN msgs) \ {m}) |-> msgs[msg] ] ELSE [ msgs EXCEPT ![m] = @ - 1 ]
IF acc = {} /\ e.source = source THEN acc \cup {e} ELSE acc
IF \E i \in 1..Len(msgs[m.dest]) : msgs[m.dest][i] = m THEN msgs ELSE OrderWithMessage(m, msgs)
CaseExpr: CASE Guarantee = OrderedNoDup -> OrderNoDupInitMessageVar [] Guarantee = Ordered -> OrderInitMessageVar [] Guarantee = ReorderedNoDup -> ReorderNoDupInitMessageVar [] Guarantee = Reordered -> ReorderDupInitMessageVar
CASE Guarantee = OrderedNoDup -> OrderNoDupMessages [] Guarantee = Ordered -> OrderMessages [] Guarantee = ReorderedNoDup -> ReorderNoDupMessages [] Guarantee = Reordered -> ReorderDupMessages

CASE Guarantee = OrderedNoDup -> OrderNoDupMessagesTo(dest, source) [] Guarantee = Ordered -> OrderMessagesTo(dest, source) [] Guarantee = ReorderedNoDup -> ReorderNoDupMessagesTo(dest, source) [] Guarantee = Reordered -> ReorderDupMessagesTo(dest, source)

CASE Guarantee = OrderedNoDup -> OrderNoDupWithMessage(m, msgs) [] Guarantee = Ordered -> OrderWithMessage(m, msgs) [] Guarantee = ReorderedNoDup -> ReorderNoDupWithMessage(m, msgs) [] Guarantee = Reordered -> ReorderDupWithMessage(m, msgs)

CASE Guarantee = OrderedNoDup -> OrderNoDupWithoutMessage(m, msgs) [] Guarantee = Ordered -> OrderWithoutMessage(m, msgs) [] Guarantee = ReorderedNoDup -> ReorderNoDupWithoutMessage(m, msgs) [] Guarantee = Reordered -> ReorderDupWithoutMessage(m, msgs)

CASE Guarantee = OrderedNoDup -> OrderNoDupOneMoreMessage(msg) [] Guarantee = Ordered -> OrderOneMoreMessage(msg) [] Guarantee = ReorderedNoDup -> ReorderNoDupOneMoreMessage(msg) [] Guarantee = Reordered -> ReorderDupOneMoreMessage(msg)

CASE Guarantee = OrderedNoDup -> OrderNoDupDropMessages(server) [] Guarantee = Ordered -> OrderDropMessages(server) [] Guarantee = ReorderedNoDup -> ReorderNoDupDropMessages [] Guarantee = Reordered -> ReorderDupDropMessages
CASE Guarantee = OrderedNoDup -> FALSE [] Guarantee = Ordered -> OrderDropMessage(sender, Test) [] Guarantee = ReorderedNoDup -> FALSE [] Guarantee = Reordered -> FALSE
